HTTP Markdown excludes hidden elements and template text by default while preserving visible text

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"never\"},\"content\":{\"extract_metadata\":false}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.markdown()?.content() as Any)
```
